summary: Frontend-only E2E of Preventative Maintenance calendar improvements for PulseFitness (owner@isodemo.com). Verified: (1) Calendar chips render SITE NAME with a numeric machine-count badge for new schedules (e.g. 'Demo Branch B' + badge '2'; 'Demo Head Office' + badge '14'). (2) Chip click opens ppm-detail modal with ppm-detail-site, allocate & delete buttons. (3) Search returns matching visits (5 for 'Demo'). (4) Bulk Scheduling Wizard end-to-end: 4 steps (sites → service+lead engineer → AI grouping → dates) — customer select works, AI grouping via Claude returned a run card ('Demo Sites · 2 sites' with Jordan Blake as lead) in ~3-10s, auto-plan produced editable per-row date+engineer, Confirm scheduled new visits which appeared correctly on the calendar (Jan 5/6 2027). (5) Manage mode with checkbox chips + Delete selected works (2 chips deleted, all confirmation dialogs auto-accepted). (6) Delete-ALL-for-a-customer modal opens, customer picker populated, confirm works. (7) Create PM modal is single-site (text: 'Schedule a single site. For many sites at once, use Bulk schedule.').

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='ppm-detail-machines' container is not rendered when the visit has 0 linked machines (e.g. seeded 15 Oct 2026 'Demo Branch B' visit shows 'No machines linked to this site' but the labelled wrapper has no testid). Requirement expects the machines list container to always be present.
Pressing Escape does not close the ppm-detail modal (had to use the ✕ button). Minor UX/keyboard-access issue.

Chips whose visit has 0 machines (older seed visits) render only the site name with no badge. Acceptable per implementation (badge suppressed when count=0) — flag only in case product wants a '—' badge for consistency.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking bulk-confirm, no visible toast text was captured by common toast/sonner selectors (visits DID appear on the calendar). Confirmation was implicit via calendar refresh — user may miss it. Consider a persistent toast with data-testid='ppm-bulk-success-toast'.

action_items: Optional: always render ppm-detail-machines wrapper (with empty-state text inside) so the testid is stable.
Optional: wire Escape key to close ppm-detail modal.
Optional: verify bulk-confirm success toast is emitted with a stable testid for end-user feedback.
critical_code_review_comments: AI grouping call (bulk-run-grouping) resolves quickly (<10s in this run) — no loading spinner testid observed; add a 'grouping in progress' state.

Search dropdown wrapper data-testid='ppm-search-results' — result items were found via [data-testid^='ppm-search-result-'] but wrapper count check inconclusive; confirm wrapper always mounts on non-empty results.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 bulk-scheduled PM visits for 'Iso Demo Fitness' — Demo Branch B on 2027-01-05 and Demo Head Office on 2027-01-06 (lead engineer Jordan Blake). Also exercised Delete Selected (removed both January visits during manage-mode test) and Delete-All-for-customer flow (executed against 'Iso Demo Fitness' — no residual visits in Jan 2027 remained).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 flows in the review request PASS. Only cosmetic/UX gaps remain (Escape not closing detail modal, missing ppm-detail-machines wrapper when 0 machines, no visible bulk-confirm toast). The bulk wizard used customer 'Iso Demo Fitness · 2 sites' (both sites ticked), engineer 'Jordan Blake'. AI grouping returned engine=ai and grouped both sites into a single 'Demo Sites' run. After the manage-mode 'Delete selected' + 'Delete ALL for customer' tests were executed, existing Iso Demo Fitness PM demo schedules for Oct/Nov 2026 may be reduced — if next agent needs those, re-run scripts/seed_site_isolation_demo.py or the PM seeder.
